statement: Implement Q10 under epic pilot-readiness-and-public-proof: a generated, regression-checked PostgreSQL compatibility certification matrix (src/query/pg/postgres-compatibility-catalog.js, src/query/pg/postgres-compatibility-matrix.js, docs/postgres-compatibility-matrix.json) covering psql, pg/node-postgres, psycopg3, and JDBC/PgJDBC across simple/extended wire, prepared statements, OIDs/types, transactions/READ COMMITTED/locking reads, DDL/system catalogs/SHOW/SET, and SQLSTATE/error mapping, backed by live pgwire receipts and negative controls without ORM overclaim.
